backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining all backend types (user profiles, rituals, challenges, quizzes, pairing, stats, love languages) and including mixins for authorization and blob storage functionality.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting implemented features including level-up celebration overlay, XP progress bar animations, badge showcase, streak milestone animations, and integration into Insights page with associated files and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including components, pages, hooks, and configuration, detailing their functionality, props, animations, and integration points.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light/dark themes, including romantic color palette and comprehensive keyframe animations for level-up celebrations, badge effects, and progress transitions.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry point with favicon links, viewport settings, and a pre-React script that initializes theme (dark/light) from localStorage to prevent flash of unstyled content.
frontend/QA_ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md: QA acceptance checklist for Version 66 reset verification and historical checklists for previous versions (76, 64, 63, 62) covering draft build labels, theme toggles, data guards, and feature removals.
frontend/QA_VERSION_66_RESET_REPORT.md: Verification report confirming successful restoration to Version 66 snapshot state, with passing status for draft build labels, build stability, core functionality, and absence of post-Version 66 features.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component managing authentication state, tab navigation, profile loading/setup flow, and conditional rendering of landing page, profile setup modal, or main app with bottom navigation.
frontend/src/components/BadgeShowcase.ts: Displays a grid of achievement badges with icons, locked/unlocked states, tooltips, and optional entrance animations; supports reduced motion preferences.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Fixed bottom navigation bar with five tabs (Home, Insights, Memories, Activities, Us) featuring icons, active state styling, and smooth transitions.
frontend/src/components/CompletionAnimat: Renders floating heart animations using randomly positioned and delayed elements for visual feedback on task completion.
frontend/src/components/CoupleLevelXPMod: Displays couple level, XP progress bar, and points with animated counter; fetches couple progress data and respects reduced motion preferences.
frontend/src/components/DataStates.tsx: Provides reusable UI components for loading, empty, error, and section header states with consistent styling, icons, and optional retry actions.
frontend/src/components/HarmonyBreakdown: Displays a detailed card showing current harmony score (0-1 normalized to percentage), 7-day trend sparkline, and breakdown of contributing factors (quiz overlap, completion rates). Includes expandable explanation section and handles insufficient data states.
Compact button component for the home screen that displays current harmony percentage and trend icon, navigating to detailed insights when clicked.
frontend/src/components/LandingBrand.tsx: Renders the GrowInLove brand logo (tree image) with text, supporting default and compact variants, with text-only fallback on image load error.
frontend/src/components/LandingFooterLin: Modal dialog component that displays content for footer links (About, Contact, Terms, Privacy, Investor) with scrollable text sections.
frontend/src/components/LandingHeroScree: Displays a single hero screenshot in a phone mockup frame with notch and rounded corners for the landing page.
Expandable section displaying the founder story text with read more/less toggle, showing first 3 paragraphs by default.
frontend/src/components/LandingScreensho: Auto-rotating carousel of app screenshots in a phone mockup with manual navigation buttons and dot indicators, cycling every 4 seconds.
frontend/src/components/LevelUpCelebrati: Full-screen modal celebration overlay with confetti animation, trophy icon, and level details that auto-dismisses after 4 seconds, respecting reduced motion preferences.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Authentication button that handles Internet Identity login/logout with loading states, clearing query cache on logout and managing authentication errors.
frontend/src/components/LoveChallenges.t: Displays a list of 15 love language challenges (e.g., daily affirmations, quality time activities) with completion tracking, filtering by love language, and animations. Uses React Query hooks to fetch and save completed challenges.
frontend/src/components/OurLoveLanguages: A reusable card component that displays love language status with a primary action button and a secondary link to insights. Supports loading states and optional highlight animation.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Initial profile setup form that prompts users to enter their name, validates input, and calls the initialize profile mutation. Shows success animation before redirecting.
frontend/src/components/RewardVisuals.ts: Displays progress visualization including challenge completion percentage, milestone badges, and streak boost indicators with multipliers. Fetches data from insights API.
frontend/src/components/SpinWheel.tsx: Interactive spinning wheel that randomly selects a love language for daily focus, with smooth easing animation and localStorage persistence to prevent multiple spins per day.
frontend/src/components/StreakMilestoneB: Shows streak milestone badges (3, 7, 14, 30, 60, 100 days) with unlock status, progress bar to next milestone, and animations for newly unlocked achievements.
frontend/src/components/ThemeToggle.tsx: Simple theme toggle button that switches between light and dark modes using a custom useTheme hook, displaying sun/moon icons.
frontend/src/components/UnlockPacks.tsx: React component that displays unlockable activity packs based on love languages, with each pack requiring a certain streak length to unlock. Includes pack definitions for Quality Time, Words of Affirmation, Physical Touch, Acts of Service, and Receiving Gifts with associated activities.
frontend/src/config/draftBuildLabel.ts: Configuration file that exports a function returning the current draft build version label ('Draft Version 66').
frontend/src/content/contact.ts: Exports the contact email address constant for the application.
frontend/src/content/founderStory.ts: Contains the founder story narrative explaining how GrowInLove was created during a four-day app competition as a tool for couples to strengthen their relationship.
Defines screenshot configurations for the landing page, including a hero screenshot and carousel screenshots with captions for various app features.
frontend/src/contexts/ThemeContext.tsx: React context provider for theme management supporting light, dark, and system modes with localStorage persistence and automatic system preference detection.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that manages the backend actor instance with authentication, handling both anonymous and authenticated states using Internet Identity and React Query.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context and hooks for login/logout functionality with AuthClient integration and delegation identity management.
frontend/src/hooks/usePrefersReducedMoti: Custom hook that detects and returns the user's reduced motion preference from system settings using media query.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks and TypeScript types for all backend API operations including user profiles, rituals, quizzes, challenges, photos, and insights data.
frontend/src/hooks/useSectionEntrance.ts: Custom hook using Intersection Observer to detect when a section enters the viewport for animation triggers, with support for reduced motion preferences.
frontend/src/hooks/useTheme.ts: Re-exports the useTheme hook from ThemeContext for backward compatibility.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file defining Tailwind directives, CSS custom properties for a romantic-themed color palette (light and dark modes), utility classes for text gradients and shadows, and keyframe animations for UI effects.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the root React component with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers.
frontend/src/pages/Activities.tsx: Activities page displaying love challenges, couple level/XP, streak badges, reward visuals, spin wheel, and unlock packs; requires authentication and pairing (or admin override).
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page for daily rituals where users submit responses (text, photo, audio) to prompts based on love languages, view ritual history, and see completion animations.
frontend/src/pages/Insights.tsx: Insights page displaying couple statistics including streaks, harmony scores, trends, milestone badges, challenge completion rates, and level-up celebrations.
frontend/src/pages/Landing.tsx: Landing page with hero section, feature highlights, screenshot carousel, brand story, privacy information, and call-to-action buttons for unauthenticated users.
frontend/src/pages/LoveLanguages.tsx: Love Languages quiz page with multi-step questions, scoring logic, results display, and backend integration for saving/loading quiz results. Maps between UI language names and backend enums.
frontend/src/pages/Memories.tsx: Displays ritual history as expandable memory cards showing date, love language focus, prompts, and responses with photos. Fetches data from backend queries.
frontend/src/pages/Us.tsx: Partner pairing page that handles generating/entering pairing codes, displays paired status, shows combined quiz results via OurLoveLanguagesCard, and includes admin status checks.
frontend/src/utils/coupleLevel.ts: Frontend-only utility for calculating couple level, XP, and progress based on insights data (streaks, challenges, harmony). Uses exponential leveling curve.
frontend/src/utils/harmony.ts: Helper functions for harmony display: converts harmony to percent, normalizes 7-day trend series, and computes trend labels with icons/colors.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: URL parameter parsing utilities supporting both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence for parameters like admin tokens.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom theme colors (romantic palette, peach, cream), font families (Nunito, Quicksand, Comfortaa), animations, and plugin integrations.
project_state.json: Project state file for a couple relationship app with gamification features including level-up celebrations, XP progress tracking, milestone badges, and animated UI components. Contains 5 implemented features focused on frontend animations and user engagement mechanics.
